message: Refuse pipe-to-shell installer pattern (curl|wget … | sh). Download to a file, inspect, then run.
Refuse truncate-to-absolute-path pattern (: > /...). Scope the path.

Don't set or override git identity: ~/.config/git/config.local resolves it per directory via includeIf, and user.useConfigOnly makes git fail loudly when a path is uncovered. Ask the user instead of choosing a value.
